title: The Cheap coat from the market
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：cheap　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cheap 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the operator wrote of ① a cheap coat from the market in the log, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② cheaper than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the operator, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the cheap ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the cheapest coat from the market anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the log for June 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too cheap to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainee who had come to help; the cheap ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a cheap excuse for the delay, and said that no trainee in his right mind would call it ⑥ as cheap as the excuse for the delay they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was cheap or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something cheap, and nothing besides. The trainee from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite cheap; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the cheap ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, before dawn, she wrote of another cheap coat from the market in the same log, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ cheaper than anybody had expected. ⑩ The cheapest excuse for the delay in the whole station, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the cheap ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 便宜（前置定语 a cheap coat from the market：1957 年操作员在运行日志里记下的那件便宜的外套）
B. adj. 便宜／廉价（比较级 cheaper than：文中两处，一处比集市上买的外套，一处比预想）
C. adj. 便宜／廉价（最高级 the cheapest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 便宜（表语 too cheap to do：母亲觉得它太便宜，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 廉价（前置定语 a cheap excuse for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩廉价的借口）
F. adj. 廉价（同级比较 as cheap as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩拖延的借口相比）
G. adj. 廉价（后置定语 something cheap：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 廉价（受程度副词修饰 quite cheap：那位实习生的评价）

items.q: a cheap coat from the market
the cheapest coat from the market anybody
a cheap excuse for the delay
The cheapest excuse for the delay in

answers.why: cheap 意为“便宜”，1957 年操作员在运行日志里记下的是“一件便宜的外套”，此处作前置定语 a cheap coat from the market。
cheap 意为“便宜”，此处用比较级 cheaper than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
cheap 意为“便宜”，运行日志上 六月 那行字说它是机房里最便宜的一件，故用最高级 the cheapest coat from the market。
cheap 意为“便宜”，母亲认为这件东西“太便宜了，谁也用不上”，too cheap to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
cheap 意为“廉价”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩廉价的借口”，此处作前置定语 a cheap excuse for the delay。
cheap 意为“廉价”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩拖延的借口一样廉价”，同级比较用 as cheap as。
cheap 意为“廉价”，运行日志上那半行字要的是“廉价的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something cheap。
cheap 意为“廉价”，邻机房来的那位实习生认为这套计划“相当廉价”，quite 修饰原级 cheap。
cheap 意为“廉价”，1967 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要廉价”，故用比较级 cheaper than。
cheap 意为“廉价”，母亲 1969 年说的是“整个机房里最廉价的那一桩”，故用最高级 the cheapest excuse for the delay。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，操作员在运行日志里记下了一件便宜的外套。（a cheap coat from the market）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更便宜。（cheaper than …）
母亲觉得它太便宜，谁也用不上。（too cheap to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩廉价的借口。（a cheap excuse for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩拖延的借口一样廉价。（as cheap as …）
到了 1964 年，运行日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件廉价的东西。（something cheap）
answers: In 1957 the operator wrote of a cheap coat from the market in the log.
Everybody said it was cheaper than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too cheap to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a cheap excuse for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as cheap as the excuse for the delay they had once had.
By 1964 the log asked for nothing but something cheap.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cheap 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the operator wrote of a cheap coat from the market in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the cheapest coat from the market in the station, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too cheap to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a cheap excuse for the delay, and nobody argued with him.
The trainee from the next station called the plan quite cheap, and everybody laughed.
The cheap ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
